description: Use when the user asks what Parse needs from them, or when a task waits on an answer. Returns the brand's open questions this user can answer (the app's "Needs you"): each with its id, its prompt and how it is answered (a choice from its list, a short text, or an email address). Read-only. Next: ask the user, then parse_answer_question with their answer.

brandSlug.description: The brand's slug or its name. Omit it to use the workspace's own brand.

name: parse_questions
title: Parse's open questions for the brand
